title: Chris Pratt Says He ‘Would Love’ James Gunn to Direct a Fourth ‘Guardians of the Galaxy’ Film After DC Exit
content:
ByMya Copeland

Chris Prattthinks it would be “awesome” to reunite withJames Gunnfor a fourth “Guardians of the Galaxy” film after the director announced his departure fromDC Studiosthis week.

Gunn and his co-chief, Peter Safran, were ousted from their positions on Nov. 9 following David Ellison’s Skydance merger in October. Marvel Studios alum Jeremy Latcham was announced as the new president and chief creative officer of DC Studios.

Theexecutive shuffle marks another setback for DC Studios, which has struggled to compete with the powerhouse that is Disney’s Marvel Cinematic Universe of late. But it opens a route for Gunn to return to the MCU, where he directed three “Guardians of the Galaxy” movies.

Pratt recently toldMoviezinethat he would love to reunite with Gunn for a fourth film in the franchise. “That would be awesome. I love working with James. He’s the man,” Pratt said when asked about the possibility of making the film. “I haven’t had a chance to speak with him since that news came out yesterday…. It’s always tough because anytime something like this comes up, it could always become a headline.”

He continued: “All I’ll say is I love James. He directed all three movies, and that’s pretty rare… so if he wanted to come back and bring it back, I would love that.”

Pratt has starred as Star-Lord in the franchise across six films, with 2014’s “Guardians of the Galaxy,” “Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2,” “Avengers: Infinity War,” “Avengers: Endgame,” “Thor: Love and Thunder” and most recently in “Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3.”

The Guardians of the Galaxy last graced the screens of viewers in 2023’s “Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3,” which promised via end-credits text that Star-Lord would return. Pratt has beenvocal about his pitchesto bring the character back andconfirmed in Octoberthat the studio has taken “hard action” to make it happen.
title_zh: 克里斯·普拉特(Chris Pratt)表示，他「非常希望」詹姆斯·古恩(James Gunn)在離開DC後能夠執導第四部《銀河護衛隊》(Guardians of the Galaxy)電影。
content_zh:
由Mya Copeland報導

克里斯·普拉特(Chris Pratt)認為，與詹姆斯·古恩(James Gunn)重聚拍攝第四部《銀河護衛隊》(Guardians of the Galaxy)電影將會是“太棒了”，這是在導演本週宣布離開DC Studios之後的想法。

古恩和他的共同首席彼得·薩夫蘭(Peter Safran)於11月9日被解除職務，此前大衛·艾利森(David Ellison)的Skydance於十月合併。漫威影業的前成員傑瑞米·拉查姆(Jeremy Latcham)被宣布為DC Studios的新總裁兼首席創意官。

這次高層人事變動對DC Studios來說又是一個挫折，該公司近期一直難以與迪士尼的漫威電影宇宙競爭。但這也為古恩回到漫威電影宇宙開啟了一條路徑，他曾執導過三部《銀河護衛隊》電影。

普拉特最近在接受《電影雜誌》(Moviezine)訪問時表示，他非常希望能與古恩重聚拍攝該系列的第四部電影。他說：“那會很棒。我喜歡和詹姆斯合作。他是個好人。”當被問及拍攝該電影的可能性時，普拉特這樣回答。“自從昨天那則新聞出來後，我還沒有機會和他交談……這總是很困難，因為每當出現這樣的事情時，它總是可能成為頭條新聞。”

他接著說：“我只想說我愛詹姆斯。他執導了所有三部電影，這是相當罕見的……所以如果他想回來並帶回這個角色，我會非常高興。”

普拉特在這個系列中飾演星爵(Star-Lord)，共參演了六部電影，包括2014年的《銀河護衛隊》(Guardians of the Galaxy)、《銀河護衛隊2》(Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2)、《復仇者聯盟：無限之戰》(Avengers: Infinity War)、《復仇者聯盟：終局之戰》(Avengers: Endgame)、《雷神索爾：愛與雷霆》(Thor: Love and Thunder)，以及最近的《銀河護衛隊3》(Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3)。

《銀河護衛隊》最後一次在觀眾面前亮相是在2023年的《銀河護衛隊3》(Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3)，該片在片尾字幕中承諾星爵將會回歸。普拉特對於將這個角色帶回來的提議表達了強烈的支持，並在十月確認該工作室已採取“強硬行動”來實現這一目標。
